kpis.description_fr: Revenu AstraZeneca 54.1 Mds$ en 2024, croissance double-digit portée par oncologie + nouveaux lancements.
kpis.description_en: AstraZeneca revenue $54.1B in 2024, double-digit growth driven by oncology and new launches.

kpis.description_fr: Revenu Oncologie 22.4 Mds$ en 2024, 41% du CA total. Tagrisso, Lynparza, Imfinzi, Enhertu, Calquence portent croissance.
kpis.description_en: Oncology revenue $22.4B in 2024, 41% of total. Tagrisso, Lynparza, Imfinzi, Enhertu, Calquence drive growth.

kpis.description_fr: Tagrisso (osimertinib) NSCLC EGFR-mutant 6.6 Mds$ en 2024, médicament #1 d'AstraZeneca. Expansion adjuvant et ADAURA.
kpis.description_en: Tagrisso (osimertinib) EGFR-mutant NSCLC $6.6B in 2024, AstraZeneca's #1 drug. Adjuvant and ADAURA expansion.

kpis.description_fr: BioPharmaceuticals (CVRM + R&I) 22.5 Mds$ en 2024. Farxiga (diabète/CKD), Fasenra (asthme), Symbicort respi.
kpis.description_en: BioPharmaceuticals (CVRM + R&I) $22.5B in 2024. Farxiga (diabetes/CKD), Fasenra (asthma), Symbicort respi.

kpis.description_fr: Maladies rares (ex-Alexion acquise 2021) 8.8 Mds$ en 2024. Ultomiris remplace Soliris franchise C5 inhibitor.
kpis.description_en: Rare Disease (ex-Alexion acquired 2021) $8.8B in 2024. Ultomiris replaces Soliris C5 inhibitor franchise.

kpis.description_fr: 30 actifs en Phase 3 fin 2024, dont ~20 nouveaux molécules entités. Pipeline le plus large parmi big pharmas.
kpis.description_en: 30 Phase 3 assets at end-2024, including ~20 new molecular entities. Largest pipeline among big pharmas.
